extracted.name: Strawberry Rhubarb Sauce
extracted.description: This strawberry rhubarb sauce is easy to make by blending cooked strawberries, rhubarb, orange juice, and sugar for a delightful fruit sauce.
instruction_lines: Combine sugar, orange juice, cornstarch, and vanilla in a large sauce pan. Bring to a boil over medium heat.

Add strawberries and rhubarb; reduce heat and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 5 to 10 minutes. Remove from heat and mash the cooked berries with a fork until blended. Stir in food coloring, if using. Serve warm or cold.
